title: Shove
description:
Make a {{jet}} ({{force}} + {{athletisme}}) opposed by the target's {{jet}} ({{force}} + {{athletisme}}) or ({{dexterite}} + {{acrobaties}}), its choice. On a success, choose one of the two effects.

***Knockdown.*** The target falls {{a-terre}}.
***Push.*** You push the target back 1.5 m.
